musselsMussels steamed in white wine, garlic and butter, with parsley and crusty breadHow to make it2 eschalots2 cloves of garlic60g butter, divided1kg cleaned mussels200ml white wine1 small bunch parsley1 loaf crusty breadChop the eschalots and garlic.Soften in some butter in a big pot.Add the mussels and wine, cover and steam until open.Toss through chopped parsley and a knob of butter.Serve with crusty bread to mop up.MainsAngel of Verdun chicken, cider and creamChicken thighs and mushrooms simmered in apple cider and cream, with baguetteHow to make it1kg chicken thighs30g butter2 eschalots, sliced200g mushrooms, sliced375ml apple cider150ml thickened cream1 small bunch parsley1 baguettesalt and pepper, to tasteSeason the chicken.Brown in butter, 4 minutes a side, then set aside.Soften the eschalots and mushrooms in the pan.Pour in the cider and scrape up the browned bits.Return the chicken, cover and simmer.Stir in the cream and simmer until glossy.Scatter with parsley and serve with a warm baguette.Farmhouse beef and mushroom stew with mashThe farmhouse where Cage and Rita hide outHow to make it1kg beef chuck, diced2 tbsp plain flour3 tbsp olive oil1 brown onion3 carrots250g Swiss brown mushrooms2 garlic cloves2 tbsp tomato paste750ml beef stock1 thyme1kg potatoes60g butter100ml milkToss the beef in the flour with salt and pepper and brown it in batches in the
